name: Seed Junky | 3.5g Prepackaged Flower | Toad Venom
description:
Toad Venom is smooth and sweet with creamy, candy notes and a gassy finish. More chill than sinister, Toad Venom settles in heavy, calming, and deeply comforting, making it a strain built for slowing down and sinking into the couch. Led by caryophyllene, myrcene, and humulene, it's an indica-style smoke made for unwinding.

Animal Face x (Sin Mints)
